// PROBE FIXTURE for tests/unit/profile-writes-single-path.test.ts.
// A fact column written as a literal, with no applyFactWrites in sight — the
// shape of the risk-profile route before Sept 2026. The guard must flag this.
// Committed per the "guards must enumerate, not assume" rule in CLAUDE.md.
import { db } from "@/lib/db"

export async function probeBypassLiteral(userId: string) {
    await db.policyholderProfile.upsert({
        where: { userId },
        update: { childrenCount: 2, answeredFields: ["childrenCount"] },
        create: { userId, childrenCount: 2, answeredFields: ["childrenCount"] },
    })
}
